steps.title: Result & scorecard
steps.body: NEET PG results are declared by NBEMS. Download your scorecard immediately — you'll need it for MCC and state registrations. Verify your category-wise percentile and AIR against the published cutoff.

steps.title: MCC PG registration
steps.body: Register on the MCC portal for 50% AIQ seats. Pay the refundable security deposit and complete profile verification. For state quota, register separately on respective state portals. Both registrations can run in parallel.
documents: MBBS degree certificate / provisional pass certificate

steps.title: Document verification
steps.body: MCC verifies uploaded documents including internship completion, medical registration, and bond affidavits. Incomplete or mismatched documents lead to rejection. For sponsored / in-service candidates, employer NOC and sponsorship letters must be uploaded during this phase.

steps.title: Choice filling by specialty & college
steps.body: Fill choices by specialty-college-seat type combination. Unlike UG, the number of permutations is much higher — e.g. 'Radiology at AIIMS Delhi (UR)' is a separate choice from 'Radiology at AIIMS Delhi (OBC)'. Lock choices before deadline; auto-lock applies the last saved preference order.
steps.timing_window: May – June (4–7 day window per round)

steps.title: Allotment
steps.body: Allotment runs across Round 1, 2, and 3. Accept the seat, float for upgrade, or free-exit (before cutoff round). Post-Round 2 exits may attract seat-leaving charges. Review the allotment letter carefully for bond obligations before accepting.

steps.title: Joining & bond execution
steps.body: Report to the allotted institute with originals within the stipulated window (typically 7 days). Execute the bond deed if required — government colleges in many states mandate a 1–3 year service bond post-PG. Pay tuition and hostel fees. Collect joining report from the institute.

steps.title: Mop-up & stray vacancy
steps.body: Unfilled seats go to mop-up round, then stray vacancy. Stray vacancy is institute-level counselling where colleges directly interview and admit from a list of eligible candidates shared by MCC / state bodies. These rounds often see movement in competitive specialties.
documents: Relieving letter (if leaving a previously joined seat)
